name: RachaConta — azul e manteiga
status: estudo após rejeição do laranja, verde escuro e mobiliário literal
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / style-transfer.
Redesign the visual treatment of the supplied RachaConta two-screen Android mockup following this user correction: no orange, terracotta, or dark green; the Brazilian boteco table was an aesthetic reference, not an object to reproduce. The app should feel attractive, refined and contemporary for Brazilian university friends sharing a bill. Preserve the two-screen flow and exact functionality, but replace the rejected rustic styling.

Output two complete app screens side by side, each at 390 x 844 logical portrait viewport. App UI only, no phones, device frames, OS bars or captions. Warm off-white base, powder-blue action surfaces, readable medium cornflower-blue highlights, warm gray everyday text, and restrained butter-yellow accents. Strong legibility without heavy dark-green type. Compact contemporary custom RachaConta wordmark, friendly clean sans-serif interface; medium-weight headings and generous whitespace. Let the boteco influence survive through one small abstract coaster-like geometric brand symbol and a tiny blue-and-butter ceramic-tile detail integrated into the header. No literal tables or chairs, photos, hand-painted advertising signs, textures, ornamental slogans, or large illustrations. Avoid generic bank-dashboard styling and boxed-everything layouts; create an elegant, purposeful native form.

Left: compact brand; “Bora rachar?”; prominent editable “Valor da conta” R$100,00; “Pessoas” minus 3 plus; “Serviço opcional” OFF switch with inactive editable 10%, helper “Só se ainda não estiver na conta.”; “Nome do encontro (opcional)” Pizza de sexta; wide powder-blue “Calcular divisão” with readable blue text; quiet “Usar exemplo”. Clean aligned fields and 48dp touch targets.

Right: back arrow and “Resultado”; “Pizza de sexta”; “Divisão por pessoa”; two spacious aligned rows with values leading visually: “2 pessoas · R$ 33,33” and “1 pessoa · R$ 33,34”; helper “Os centavos fecham o total.”; quiet breakdown Conta R$100,00, Serviço R$0,00, Total R$100,00; switch OFF “Incluir serviço de 10%”; “Editar conta”. Keep all essential content comfortably visible. Crisp Portuguese, body labels 14–16sp, no nested cards, added features or extra copy.
